**Overview**

&nbsp;

Vision is an old, but functional and simple, data acquisition system that is directly compatible with OpticsFoundry's control software [Optics_Foundry_Control_AQuRA](https://github.com/opticsfoundry/OpticsFoundry_Control_AQuRA).



**Vision**

&nbsp;

Vision has now convenient configuration files. Ask me if you need a modern version.

&nbsp;

PythonMultiCameraServer is a Python program that gives Vision access to Basler cameras. It can easily be adapted to other types of cameras.

&nbsp;

Install Borland C++ 5.02 according to the instructions in the readme file in the installation zip file.

&nbsp;

Use Visual Studio to clone Vision_AQuRA from OpticsFoundry github.

&nbsp;

Open Vision\\Vision.ide.

&nbsp;

Adjust paths in "Optionen -> Projekt":

&nbsp;

![A screenshot of a computer

AI-generated content may be incorrect.](data:image/png;base64,)

&nbsp;

Do "Projekt -> Projekt neu compilieren"

&nbsp;

If error "can't read resource file", quit Borland and load Vision.ide again, and Do "Projekt -> Projekt neu compilieren" again.

&nbsp;

Execute Vision by "Debug -> Ausführen"

&nbsp;

If you want you can also use "Vision.bat" to repeatedly open Vision. (Vision closes automatically when client (=Control.exe) disconnects. That's because I couldn't figure out how to keep TCP/IP server in listening mode after client disconnect.)

&nbsp;
